title: South Korean President's State Visit and Austrian Chancellor's Official Visit, April 2026
text: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung paid a three-day state visit to India from April 19 to 21, 2026. He was received at the airport by Union Minister of State Harsh Malhotra, and External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar called on him. On April 20, Lee received a ceremonial welcome at Rashtrapati Bhavan. He then held bilateral talks with Prime Minister Narendra Modi at Hyderabad House in New Delhi, after which the two leaders planted a tree to symbolise the growing partnership. The two sides unveiled a Joint Strategic Vision for the India-Republic of Korea Special Strategic Partnership for 2026-2030. Three joint statements were also issued, covering shipbuilding and maritime logistics, sustainability, and energy resource security. During the visit, South Korea joined the Indo-Pacific Oceans Initiative. On April 20, business leaders from both countries held an India-Korea Business Forum in New Delhi. There, POSCO and JSW Steel signed a joint venture agreement to build a 6 million tonnes per annum greenfield integrated steel plant in Odisha. Under the structure disclosed in JSW's filing, the venture will be a 50:50 partnership between JSW and the POSCO Group. Earlier in April, Austrian Chancellor Christian Stocker made an official visit to India from April 14 to 17, 2026, his first visit to the country. The visit produced several MoUs, including one between India's FSSAI and Austria's AGES on food safety, and another between IIT Delhi and Montan University.
